newsitem.title: CHINA: ICBC Shanghai transfers forex credit business.
newsitem.headline: ICBC Shanghai transfers forex credit business.

text.p: The Shanghai branch of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) has decided to transfer its foreign exchange credit business to subsidiaries, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

The bank's international business department would no longer be in charge of foreign exchange credit business from July 1 and would be mainly responsible for the administration of foreign exchange loans, Xinhua said without elaborating.
The move would help prevent risks related to extending loans in foreign exchange, it quoted unidentified analysts as saying.

The new measure covers loans for technical renovation, marginal loans for foreign-funded enterprises, loans for circulating funds and loans that have been approved but not yet extended, the news agency said.

Seventy-five percent of the value of all loans extended by the bank's international business department would be affected by the new measure, Xinhua quoted the bank as saying. It gave no further details.
